proof_limit: Observability study. Paired capture latency median must be within 3% of its plain arm per shape/input/width for causal timing comparison.
profile: Userspace 503009ns CPU clocks and 2500009-cycle PMU events after SDK warmups. Five pairs of symbol-derived entry/return events; all proofs independently verified.
scope: Warm single proofs on 16 physical Ryzen 9950X cores. At 16+8 main workers occupy both threads of the eight first-CCD cores. At 24+8 there are eight extra main workers sharing physical cores with frontend. Profile CPU sample intervals include all process threads; adjacent wall phases are delimited by SDK, core, solver, folded quotient and final exponentiation function boundaries.
